notes: The PDF has only the two instruction pages and no inventory pages, so Element IDs were inferred from the pictures. Catalogue types are used where a piece looked close, and new types are used otherwise. The IDs lego-3034, lego-3660 and lego-3705 are best guesses. The grille and axle-holder types use descriptive ids because the real Element IDs are unknown.
Piece sizes and some attachment points (b4, b5, b7, b8, b10, b13, b16) are read from small pictures and may be off. Step 5 shows no clearly new pieces, so none were added.
lego-3020 (catalogue: plate 2x4 with side wheel pins) is used as a plain yellow 2x4 plate, and its pin ports are not used.

The two axle sets (axle holder plate, axle and two wheels) are shown from below in step 8 and fitted in step 12. They are modelled as one repeat of 2. Both copies attach to b1, so the front and rear positions are not distinguished.
The grille (b9) and the yellow 1x2 brick (b10) at the front are approximated as attached to b1.
The dump bed is fixed to the chassis. The set has no tipping hinge in these pages.
